## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Confirmations: mixed sector breadth and split leadership—defensive/Financials (UNH, KHC, CVS, USB) are strong while Big Tech (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) is BELOW TREND, producing neutral signals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: UNH (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: KHC (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +5.27%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND. Financials positive: USB (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +4.26%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +6.58% | 1M: +8.41%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND; Technology 1W performance -8.39% (broad weakness). Materials and Industrials weak: FCX (1W: -12.12% | 1M: -3.56%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -13.68% | 1M: -22.94%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -10.39%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Top 5: UNH (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND; KHC (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +5.27%) ABOVE TREND; CVS (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND; PSA (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND; USB (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +4.26%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -10.04% | 1M: +15.93%) TREND EXHAUSTION; CRM (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND; ETN (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -10.39%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -10.89% | 1M: +21.83%) TREND EXHAUSTION; FCX (1W: -12.12% | 1M: -3.56%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: UNH (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND, KHC (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +5.27%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND; Major divergence present (NOW, IBM, ORCL, AVGO show 1W vs 1M conflicts) — tactical caution, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology under pressure with concentrated downside: AAPL (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -8.39% indicating broad selling and trend risk.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are constructive: JPM (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +4.26%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +6.58% | 1M: +8.41%) ABOVE TREND; Financials 1W: +2.70% supports continued relative strength.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing strength and leadership: UNH (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare 1W: +2.99% with some idiosyncratic legal/news risk (JNJ).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Financials and Healthcare (JPM (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Technology where AAPL (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND are weak; Style: Value/Defensive tilt while NEUTRAL breadth persists.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned; UNH (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through candidate; CVS (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MA (1W: +3.72% | 1M: -1.75%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL on heavy negative sentiment; V (1W: +3.38% | 1M: -0.07%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL; NOW (1W: -10.04% | 1M: +15.93%) TREND EXHAUSTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +5.37%) and Financials (1W: +2.70% | 1M: +2.54%) for continued leadership. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -0.08%) and Materials (1W: -3.68% | 1M: -4.93%) where downside risk persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor Tech leadership reprieve or failure: A sustained weekly recovery in NVDA (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -8.56%) would signal reduced downside risk; AAPL (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -0.38%) holding its monthly trend would limit broader Tech spillover; JPM (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +3.05%) extending weekly strength would reinforce Financials leadership; watch NOW (1W: -10.04% | 1M: +15.93%) for confirmation of trend exhaustion vs rebound.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+75): FDA nod for extended dosing; price confirming — LLY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND and sentiment aligned. AVGO (+50): post-earnings buy thesis but price diverging — AVGO (1W: -22.35% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, bullish headline but selling persists (distribution).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MA (-85): swipe-fee settlement headline weighing; MA (1W: +3.72% | 1M: -1.75%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL and sentiment-confirmed risk. V (-60): same settlement risk; V (1W: +3.38% | 1M: -0.07%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL and needs follow-through. NOW (-45): security incident; NOW (1W: -10.04% | 1M: +15.93%) TREND EXHAUSTION and news confirms immediate downside pressure. JNJ (-45): talc verdict headline but JNJ (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND shows divergence—monitor legal risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Defensive style. UNH (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk is major divergence in Technology (AAPL (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -22.35% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND) and several trend-exhaustion names—watch for trend breaks and news-confirmed follow-through.
